PreInvocation.command: p=$(command -v pond 2>/dev/null || echo /Applications/Mergepond.app/Contents/Resources/agents/pond); out=$(if [ -x "$p" ]; then "$p" hook antigravity 2>/dev/null; fi); if [ -n "$out" ]; then echo "$out"; else echo '{}'; fi; exit 0

Stop.command: p=$(command -v pond 2>/dev/null || echo /Applications/Mergepond.app/Contents/Resources/agents/pond); out=$(if [ -x "$p" ]; then "$p" hook antigravity 2>/dev/null; fi); if [ -n "$out" ]; then echo "$out"; else echo '{}'; fi; exit 0
